pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: Change matches the PR words: a no-match search says no item matches it, and an empty table still says 'No items yet.'. It is a bug fix with one obvious design.
No spec file in the change.
Three new tests in test/search.test.js cover the no-match message, escaping, and the empty-table case. Each would fail against the old code. Not run here; CI runs them.
The diff touches no docs, and the grep found no doc that mentions the message.
The extra COUNT query runs only when a search returns nothing. The message is built by escapeHtml and then inserted unescaped into the template, which is correct because it is already escaped.
The search term is escaped in the new message, and a test covers it. No new injection path.
The only UI change is one line of message text in an HTML paragraph.
The only UI change is one line of message text in an HTML paragraph.
The title is under 72 characters and the body claims match the diff.
